# Driveway Gates Kent

> A free quote service for driveway gates in Kent. Homeowners describe their entrance and up to three Kent gate installers arrange a site survey and a written quote.

## About

Driveway Gates Kent is a free quote service that connects Kent homeowners with driveway gate installers. Homeowners pay nothing to use the service and are under no obligation to go ahead. Installers pay a referral fee only when a job goes ahead. The site also publishes guides on Kent planning rules, coastal corrosion, gate safety (BS EN 12453) and costs.

## Services

- Electric Sliding Gates: /services/electric-sliding-gates/
- Electric Swing Gates: /services/electric-swing-gates/
- Wooden Driveway Gates: /services/wooden-driveway-gates/
- Metal Driveway Gates: /services/metal-driveway-gates/
- Automated Gate Systems: /services/automated-gate-systems/
- Gate Repair and Maintenance: /services/gate-repair-and-maintenance/

## Coverage

Enquiries are taken across all 13 Kent council areas: Sevenoaks, Tonbridge and Malling, Tunbridge Wells, Maidstone, Dartford, Gravesham, Medway, Canterbury, Swale, Ashford, Folkestone and Hythe, Dover, and Thanet. This includes the West Kent commuter belt (Sevenoaks, Tunbridge Wells), the Kent Downs and High Weald National Landscapes (formerly AONBs), and the coast from Whitstable and Herne Bay round through Thanet (Margate, Broadstairs, Ramsgate) to Folkestone, Hythe, and the Romney Marsh edge.

- Location pages: /location/

## Key Facts

- Service area: the county of Kent, all 13 council areas
- Cost to homeowners: free, no obligation
- Coastal specialism: marine-grade aluminium, hot-dip galvanising, A4 stainless fixings, and Accoya for salt-air exposure
- Typical installation: 2 to 4 working days
- Up to three written quotes, each after a site survey
